(--text-muted)">Crea uno desde un clone.</p></div>';
      return;
    }
    c.innerHTML = filtered.map(function (pr) {
      var approvals = (pr.reviews || []).filter(function (r) { return r.state === "approved"; }).length;
      return '<div class="pr-card" data-id="' + escapeHtml(pr.id) + '"><div class="title">' +
        escapeHtml(pr.title) + ' <span class="state-' + escapeHtml(pr.state) + '">(' + escapeHtml(pr.state) + ")</span></div>" +
        '<div class="meta">' + escapeHtml(pr.author || "") + " · " + escapeHtml(pr.head) + " → " + escapeHtml(pr.base) +
        (approvals ? " · ✓ " + approvals + " approve" : "") + "</div></div>";
    }).join("");
    c.querySelectorAll(".pr-card").forEach(function (card) {
      card.onclick = function () { showPrDetail(card.getAttribute("data-id")); };
    });
  }
